name: Nerull's Shade

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Doom Shade
traits.details: Each enemy in the aura takes a –4 penalty to saving throws.

traits.name: Seething Divinity
traits.details: While Nerull’s shade is stunned, dazed, or dominated, any enemy that ends its turn in the aura takes 30 necrotic and radiant damage.

traits.name: Death's Evasion
traits.details: Whenever Nerull’s shade is subjected to an effect that a save can end, the shade immediately makes a saving throw against the effect. On a successful save, the effect immediately ends.

traits.name: Insubstantial
traits.details: Nerull’s shade takes half damage from all attacks, except those that deal force damage or psychic damage.

auras.name: Doom Shade
auras.details: Each enemy in the aura takes a –4 penalty to saving throws.

auras.name: Seething Divinity
auras.details: While Nerull’s shade is stunned, dazed, or dominated, any enemy that ends its turn in the aura takes 30 necrotic and radiant damage.

hit.description: necrotic and radiant damage (or 35 + 6d10 necrotic and radiant damage if Nerull’s shade scores a critical hit), and the target cannot regain hit points (save ends).

Nerull’s shade slides the target up to 5 squares, and the target uses an at-will attack power against a creature of the shade’s choice. If the target misses, it takes ongoing 30 necrotic and psychic damage (save ends).

effect.description: The shade makes two basic attacks.

powers.name: Living Conduit
powers.requirements: Nerull’s shade must be adjacent to a living creature.

effect.description: Nerull’s shade teleports to an unoccupied space adjacent to a different living creature in the shade’s line of sight. The creature must make a death saving throw.
Nerull’s shade shifts up to its speed. Each time Nerull’s shade moves within 3 squares of an enemy for the first time during the move, the shade uses Lifecutter’s shade against that enemy.

powers.name: Reaping
powers.trigger: A creature is hit by Lifecutter’s shade

effect.description: The hit becomes a critical hit.
